business.title: Open a table tab
business.goal: Open a tab for an available restaurant table.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Open a tab and mark the selected table as occupied.

outcome.statement: An open tab is linked to the selected table.
evidence: The tab has an open status and identifies the table.
The table is shown as occupied.

business.title: Add an item to an open tab
business.goal: Record a menu item, quantity, and optional preparation note on an open tab.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Review the current tab and its launched items.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Find the menu item to launch.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Review the menu item and its current price.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Launch the selected menu item with its quantity and optional note.

outcome.statement: The item is recorded on the open tab.
evidence: The tab lists the new item with its quantity, note, and charged price.
The tab total reflects the launched item.

business.title: Cancel a mistakenly launched item
business.goal: Cancel an item launched by mistake while its tab remains open.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Review the items launched on the open tab.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Cancel the item that was launched by mistake.

outcome.statement: The mistakenly launched item is cancelled and no longer contributes to the tab total.
evidence: The item is identified as cancelled on the tab.
The tab total is recalculated without the cancelled item.

business.title: Close and settle a table tab
business.goal: Settle an open tab with an optional discount and payment method, then free its table.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Review the launched items and total due.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Record a discount when one applies to the tab.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Record the payment method and amount used to settle the tab.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Close the settled tab and free its table.

outcome.statement: The tab is closed, its payment is recorded, and the table is available again.
evidence: The tab has a closed status, final total, and any applied discount.
A payment record shows the registered payment method and amount.
The associated table is shown as available.
